name: Color Scheme Field
description: Provides a 'Color Scheme' field type that stores the machine name of one scheme chosen from options a theme declares in its .info.yml; ships a select widget and no formatter, exposing the choice to themes via hook_entity_view.
project_description:
Color Scheme Field 
 Contains a field that allows to choose between color schemes defined in the default theme.

 before enabling the module, add a list of color scheme options to your default theme:

 

color_scheme:

 scheme-one: Scheme one

 scheme-two: Scheme two

 

 Once enabled you will have a new field type "Color Scheme" that you can choose from.
